    <style>
      /* ==== Thème Prism « tomorrow » (intégré) ==== */
      code[class*="language-"],
      pre[class*="language-"] {
        color: #ccc;
        background: 0 0;
        font-family: "Fira Code", Consolas, Monaco, "Andale Mono", "Ubuntu Mono",
          monospace;
        font-size: 1em;
        text-align: left;
        white-space: pre;
        word-spacing: normal;
        word-break: normal;
        word-wrap: normal;
        line-height: 1.5;
        -moz-tab-size: 4;
        -o-tab-size: 4;
        tab-size: 4;
        -webkit-hyphens: none;
        -moz-hyphens: none;
        -ms-hyphens: none;
        hyphens: none;
      }
      .token.block-comment,
      .token.cdata,
      .token.comment,
      .token.doctype,
      .token.prolog {
        color: #999;
      }
      .token.punctuation {
        color: #ccc;
      }
      .token.attr-name,
      .token.deleted,
      .token.namespace,
      .token.tag {
        color: #e2777a;
      }
      .token.function-name {
        color: #6196cc;
      }
      .token.boolean,
      .token.function,
      .token.number {
        color: #f08d49;
      }
      .token.class-name,
      .token.constant,
      .token.property,
      .token.symbol {
        color: #f8c555;
      }
      .token.atrule,
      .token.builtin,
      .token.important,
      .token.keyword,
      .token.selector {
        color: #cc99cd;
      }
      .token.attr-value,
      .token.char,
      .token.regex,
      .token.string,
      .token.variable {
        color: #7ec699;
      }
      .token.entity,
      .token.operator,
      .token.url {
        color: #67cdcc;
      }
      .token.bold,
      .token.important {
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .token.italic {
        font-style: italic;
      }
      .token.entity {
        cursor: help;
      }
      .token.inserted {
        color: green;
      }

      /* ==== Variables du thème « Arène JavaScript » ==== */
      :root {
        --js-yellow: #f7df1e;
        --js: #f7df1e;
        --js-ink: #0a0c14;
        --neon-blue: #00f3ff;
        --neon-pink: #ff2d78;
        --neon-green: #22ff88;
        --cyber-dark: #0a0c14;
        --text: #e2e8f0;
        --muted: #9ca3af;
        --dim: #6b7280;
        --gray-700: #374151;
        --gray-800: #1f2937;
        --gray-900: #111827;
        --code-bg: #0d1120;
        --code-line: #1e293b;
        --blue: #60a5fa;
        --cyan: #22d3ee;
        --green: #34d399;
        --red: #fb7185;
        --glass: rgba(16, 20, 34, 0.72);
        --glass-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
        padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
      }
      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      html {
        scroll-padding-top: calc(var(--topbar-h, 96px) + 8px);
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        html {
          scroll-behavior: auto;
        }
        .bg-mesh,
        .grid-floor,
        .title-glow,
        .ping {
          animation: none !important;
        }
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: var(--cyber-dark);
        color: var(--text);
        font-family: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial,
          sans-serif;
        line-height: 1.55;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        min-height: 100vh;
      }
      code,
      .mono,
      table td code,
      .sig,
      .font-mono-code {
        font-family: "Fira Code", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
      }
      h1,
      h2,
      h3,
      .brand-name,
      .font-heading {
        font-family: "Orbitron", "Trebuchet MS", "Arial Black", sans-serif;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
      }

      /* ==== Calques de fond (identiques au quiz) ==== */
      .bg-mesh {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 0;
        background: radial-gradient(
            ellipse 60% 50% at 15% 20%,
            rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.08),
            transparent 50%
          ),
          radial-gradient(
            ellipse 50% 50% at 85% 80%,
            rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.08),
            transparent 50%
          ),
          radial-gradient(
            ellipse 40% 40% at 60% 10%,
            rgba(255, 45, 120, 0.05),
            transparent 50%
          );
        animation: meshDrift 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      @keyframes meshDrift {
        0% {
          filter: hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1);
          transform: scale(1);
        }
        100% {
          filter: hue-rotate(40deg) saturate(1.3);
          transform: scale(1.08);
        }
      }
      #particle-canvas {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 1;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .grid-floor {
        position: fixed;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        height: 45vh;
        z-index: 0;
        background-image: linear-gradient(
            rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.07) 1px,
            transparent 1px
          ),
          linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px);
        background-size: 44px 44px;
        transform: perspective(420px) rotateX(62deg) scale(1.6);
        transform-origin: bottom;
        opacity: 0.5;
        animation: gridScroll 3.5s linear infinite;
        mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), transparent);
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
          to top,
          rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9),
          transparent
        );
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      @keyframes gridScroll {
        to {
          background-position: 0 44px, 0 44px;
        }
      }
      .scanlines {
        position: relative;
      }
      .scanlines::before {
        content: " ";
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
            rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%,
            rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22) 50%
          ),
          linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.02),
            rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.01),
            rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.02)
          );
        z-index: 60;
        background-size: 100% 3px, 3px 100%;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0.55;
      }

      /* ==== Effet verre ==== */
      .glass-panel,
      .card,
      .fn-box,
      aside#side {
        background: var(--glass);
        backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
        border: 1px solid var(--glass-line);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      }

      /* ==== Barre du haut ==== */
      nav.topbar {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 50;
        padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
        background: rgba(13, 16, 26, 0.85);
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
      }
      .topbar-inner {
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 10px 14px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 14px;
      }
      .brand-col {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .logo {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: var(--text);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .js-badge {
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.55);
        transition: transform 0.2s;
      }
      .logo:hover .js-badge {
        transform: rotate(6deg);
      }
      .brand-text {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-width: 0;
        line-height: 1.25;
      }
      .brand-name {
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        color: #fff;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .brand-name em {
        font-style: normal;
        color: var(--js-yellow);
      }
      .ver {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 1px 6px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.1);
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        border: 1px solid rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.3);
      }
      .brand-sub {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--dim);
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .author {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        min-width: 0;
        padding-left: 46px;
      }
      .author-logo {
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        object-fit: contain;
        border-radius: 6px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .author-mono {
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 0.6rem;
      }
      .author-txt {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .navlinks {
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .navbtn {
        font-family: "Fira Code", Consolas, monospace;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        color: #d1d5db;
        background: rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
        transition: all 0.2s;
        white-space: nowrap;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .navbtn:hover {
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        border-color: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.5);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      .navbtn.active {
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        border-color: var(--js-yellow);
        font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }
      .navbtn.active:hover {
        background: #fde047;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.4);
        color: #000;
      }
      .menu-btn {
        display: none;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        padding: 8px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        background: rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
        color: #d1d5db;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s;
      }
      .menu-btn:hover {
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        border-color: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.5);
      }

      /* ==== Bandeau de progression ==== */
      .course-bar {
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
        background: rgba(10, 12, 20, 0.6);
        position: relative;
      }
      .course-bar-inner {
        padding: 5px 14px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 10px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
      }
      .course-bar-left {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        min-width: 0;
        flex: 1;
      }
      .course-level-badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        background: rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.08);
        color: var(--cyan);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.3);
        padding: 2px 9px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .course-sep {
        color: var(--dim);
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .course-sec-step {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        padding: 1px 7px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .course-sec-name {
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }
      .course-bar-right {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .course-mini-track {
        width: 84px;
        height: 6px;
        background: var(--gray-800);
        border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        border-radius: 999px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .course-mini-fill {
        height: 100%;
        width: 0%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--js-yellow));
        border-radius: 999px;
        transition: width 0.12s ease-out;
      }
      .course-pct {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        min-width: 3.4ch;
        text-align: right;
      }
      .course-progress-track {
        height: 3px;
        width: 100%;
        background: rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.6);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .course-progress-fill {
        height: 100%;
        width: 0%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--js-yellow));
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.6);
        transition: width 0.1s ease-out;
      }

      /* ==== Mise en page ==== */
      .layout {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 10;
      }
      .content {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      aside#side {
        position: sticky;
        top: var(--topbar-h, 64px);
        flex: 0 0 210px;
        width: 210px;
        max-height: calc(100vh - var(--topbar-h, 64px));
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 12px 8px 20px 10px;
        border: none;
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
        border-radius: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
      }
      aside#side a {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: var(--muted);
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        transition: all 0.15s;
        position: relative;
        counter-increment: side;
      }
      aside#side {
        counter-reset: side;
      }
      aside#side a::before {
        content: counter(side, decimal-leading-zero) " ";
        color: var(--dim);
        font-size: 0.68rem;
      }
      aside#side a:hover {
        background: rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.6);
        color: #fff;
        transform: translateX(4px);
      }
      aside#side a.active {
        background: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.1);
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        border-color: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.3);
        box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.12);
      }
      aside#side a.active::before {
        color: var(--js-yellow);
      }

      /* ==== En-tête de la page ==== */
      header {
        padding: 28px 18px 10px;
        text-align: left;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }
      .eyebrow {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 4px 12px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.3);
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }
      .eyebrow .ping {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        position: relative;
      }
      .eyebrow .ping::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        animation: ping 1s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
      }
      @keyframes ping {
        75%,
        100% {
          transform: scale(2.4);
          opacity: 0;
        }
      }
      h1 {
        font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3rem);
        margin: 0.4em 0 0.25em;
        font-weight: 900;
        line-height: 1.1;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fef08a, #fcd34d, #eab308);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        background-clip: text;
        color: transparent;
      }
      .title-glow {
        animation: titleGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      @keyframes titleGlow {
        0%,
        100% {
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.35));
        }
        50% {
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.6));
        }
      }
      header p {
        color: var(--muted);
        max-width: 64ch;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 0.98rem;
      }
      header p .kbd {
        margin: 0 2px;
      }
      .kbd {
        font-family: "Fira Code", Consolas, monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        padding: 1px 6px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        border-bottom-width: 3px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        color: #d1d5db;
      }

      main {
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 8px 18px 48px;
      }

      /* ==== Sections ==== */
      .section {
        margin-bottom: 34px;
        animation: popIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
      }
      @keyframes popIn {
        0% {
          transform: scale(0.97);
          opacity: 0;
        }
        100% {
          transform: scale(1);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
      .section h2 {
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        margin: 0 0 14px;
        padding: 8px 16px 8px 14px;
        background: rgba(16, 20, 34, 0.8);
        border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        border-left: 3px solid var(--js-yellow);
        border-radius: 10px;
        display: inline-block;
        max-width: 100%;
        color: #fff;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        line-height: 1.35;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.08);
      }
      .section h2::before {
        content: "// ";
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .section h2 .note {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        text-transform: none;
        margin: 0 0 0 8px;
        font-weight: 400;
        display: inline-block;
        vertical-align: middle;
        padding: 2px 8px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.08);
        color: var(--cyan);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.25);
      }
      .grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 420px), 1fr));
        gap: 14px;
      }

      /* ==== Cartes ==== */
      .card {
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 18px 20px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
          border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
      }
      .card:hover {
        border-color: rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.25);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
          0 0 24px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.06),
          inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      }
      .card h3 {
        margin: 0 0 10px;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .card h3::before {
        content: "";
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--js-yellow);
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .card h3 code {
        text-transform: none;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        color: var(--cyan);
      }
      .card p {
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .card strong {
        color: #fff;
      }

      /* ==== Tableaux ==== */
      table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }
      table.wide {
        min-width: 0;
      }
      th,
      td {
        text-align: left;
        padding: 9px 10px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.6);
        vertical-align: top;
      }
      th {
        color: var(--dim);
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }
      td {
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }
      td code,
      th code,
      p code,
      li code,
      .fn-desc code,
      .exo-txt code,
      .note code {
        color: var(--blue);
        background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
        padding: 1px 6px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 0.85em;
      }
      tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: none;
      }
      tr:hover td {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
      }
      .ok {
        color: var(--neon-green);
      }
      .no {
        color: var(--neon-pink);
      }

      /* ==== Blocs de code (style « exercice.js » du quiz) ==== */
      pre {
        position: relative;
        background: var(--code-bg) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--code-line);
        border-radius: 0.75rem;
        padding: 36px 16px 14px !important;
        overflow-x: auto;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        margin: 10px 0 0;
        line-height: 1.6;
        box-shadow: inset 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
        font-family: "Fira Code", Consolas, monospace;
        color: #ccc;
      }
      pre::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 11px;
        left: 14px;
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7);
        box-shadow: 16px 0 0 rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.7),
          32px 0 0 rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7);
      }
      pre::after {
        content: attr(data-file);
        position: absolute;
        top: 7px;
        right: 12px;
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 10px;
        color: var(--dim);
      }
      pre code {
        background: none;
        border: none;
        padding: 0;
        font-size: inherit;
        color: inherit;
      }
      pre .c,
      .token.comment {
        color: #6b7280;
      }
      .note {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-style: italic;
      }

      /* ==== Exercices ==== */
      .exo {
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.6);
        padding: 12px 0;
      }
      .exo:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
      }
      .exo summary {
        cursor: pointer;
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: baseline;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        color: #e5e7eb;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        margin: -6px -8px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      }
      .exo summary:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        transform: translateX(5px);
      }
      .exo summary::-webkit-details-marker {
        display: none;
      }
      .exo summary::before {
        content: "▸";
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        transition: transform 0.15s;
      }
      .exo[open] summary::before {
        transform: rotate(90deg);
      }
      .exo[open] summary {
        color: #fff;
      }
      .exo-num {
        color: #000;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        min-width: 1.8em;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.35);
      }
      .exo-txt {
        flex: 1;
      }
      .exo pre {
        margin-top: 12px;
        animation: popIn 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
      }

      .compare {
        overflow-x: auto;
      }
      .compare table {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      /* ==== Boutons / boîtes extensibles (fonctions Math, chaînes…) ==== */
      .fn-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .fnbtn {
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 7px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        background: rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.8);
        color: var(--cyan);
        transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s,
          background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      }
      .fnbtn::after {
        content: " ▾";
        color: var(--js-yellow);
      }
      .fnbtn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        border-color: rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.5);
        box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.15);
      }
      .fnbtn:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--js-yellow);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      .fnbtn[aria-expanded="true"] {
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        border-color: var(--js-yellow);
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.4);
      }
      .fnbtn[aria-expanded="true"]::after {
        content: " ▴";
        color: #000;
      }
      .fn-panel {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-rows: 0fr;
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: grid-template-rows 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s;
      }
      .fn-panel.open {
        grid-template-rows: 1fr;
        visibility: visible;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      .fn-inner {
        overflow: hidden;
        min-height: 0;
      }
      .fn-box {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--js-yellow);
        border-radius: 16px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.3fr);
        column-gap: 24px;
        align-content: start;
        padding: 18px 22px;
      }
      .fn-box .sig,
      .fn-box .fn-desc,
      .fn-box .note {
        grid-column: 1;
      }
      .fn-box .sig {
        color: var(--js-yellow);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
      }
      .fn-desc {
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }
      .fn-box pre {
        grid-column: 2;
        grid-row: 1 / span 3;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        align-self: start;
      }
      .fn-box .note {
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .fn-panel {
          transition: none;
        }
      }

      /* ==== Pied de page ==== */
      footer {
        margin: 20px auto 0;
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--dim);
        font-family: "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        padding: 22px 14px 32px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.6);
        position: relative;
        z-index: 10;
      }
      footer .credit {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #d1d5db;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      footer .credit .js-badge {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        border-radius: 6px;
      }

      /* ==== Bouton « revenir en haut » ==== */
      .back-to-top {
        position: fixed;
        right: 18px;
        bottom: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
        z-index: 40;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 7px;
        width: 44px;
        height: 44px;
        padding: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: none;
        background: var(--js-yellow);
        color: #000;
        font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.55);
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.92);
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s ease, visibility 0.22s,
          background 0.15s;
      }
      .back-to-top span {
        display: none;
      }
      .back-to-top.visible {
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      .back-to-top:hover {
        background: #fde047;
        transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.04);
      }
      .back-to-top:active {
        transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
      }
      .back-to-top:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--cyan);
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }

      /* ==== Barre de défilement ==== */
      ::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
      }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: #0d1117;
      }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #2a3448;
        border-radius: 3px;
      }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: #f7df1e;
      }

      /* ==== Responsive ==== */
      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .menu-btn {
          display: inline-block;
        }
        aside#side {
          position: fixed;
          left: 0;
          z-index: 45;
          background: rgba(13, 16, 26, 0.96);
          transform: translateX(-105%);
          transition: transform 0.2s;
          border-right: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
          border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
        }
        aside#side.open {
          transform: none;
        }
        .fn-box {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .fn-box pre {
          grid-column: 1;
          grid-row: auto;
          margin-top: 10px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .course-mini-track {
          display: none;
        }
        .brand-sub,
        .author {
          display: none;
        }
        .back-to-top {
          right: 14px;
          bottom: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
        }
        .navbtn span.lbl {
          display: none;
        }
        .brand-name {
          font-size: 0.72rem;
          white-space: normal;
          display: block;
          line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .navbtn.active {
          font-size: 0.65rem;
          padding: 8px 9px;
        }
        .brand-name .ver {
          display: none;
        }
        .section h2 {
          font-size: 0.9rem;
          letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        header {
          padding: 20px 14px 8px;
        }
        main {
          padding: 8px 12px 40px;
        }
        .card {
          padding: 14px 14px;
        }
      }

      /* ==== Bouton magique permanent sous le header : Recap-JavaScript ==== */
      #btn-magique-js-recap {
        position: fixed;
        top: calc(var(--topbar-h, 88px) + 10px);
        right: 14px;
        z-index: 44;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 9px 16px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 2px solid #0a0c14;
        background: linear-gradient(125deg, #f7df1e 0%, #f59e0b 32%, #ff2d78 68%, #00f3ff 100%);
        background-size: 260% 260%;
        color: #0a0c14;
        font: 800 13px/1.1 "Orbitron", "Fira Code", system-ui, sans-serif;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        box-shadow: 3.5px 3.5px 0 #0a0c14, 0 0 18px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.52);
        animation: stiMagieInfini 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
        overflow: hidden;
        user-select: none;
      }
      #btn-magique-js-recap::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%;
        left: -60%;
        width: 42%;
        height: 200%;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.65) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%);
        transform: rotate(25deg);
        animation: stiMagieReflet 2.8s linear infinite;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      #btn-magique-js-recap .baguette {
        display: inline-block;
        font-size: 16px;
        animation: stiBaguette 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
      }
      #btn-magique-js-recap .etincelle {
        display: inline-block;
        font-size: 13px;
        animation: stiEtincelle 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      #btn-magique-js-recap:hover {
        transform: translate(-2px, -2px) scale(1.04);
        box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #0a0c14, 0 0 26px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.85);
      }
      #btn-magique-js-recap:active {
        transform: translate(1px, 1px) scale(0.98);
      }
      @keyframes stiMagieInfini {
        0%, 100% {
          background-position: 0% 50%;
          transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
          box-shadow: 3.5px 3.5px 0 #0a0c14, 0 0 14px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.48), 0 0 26px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.35);
        }
        50% {
          background-position: 100% 50%;
          transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);
          box-shadow: 4.5px 5.5px 0 #0a0c14, 0 0 24px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.82), 0 0 36px rgba(255, 45, 120, 0.55);
        }
      }
      @keyframes stiMagieReflet {
        0% { left: -65%; }
        65%, 100% { left: 135%; }
      }
      @keyframes stiBaguette {
        0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1); }
        50% { transform: rotate(16deg) scale(1.18); }
      }
      @keyframes stiEtincelle {
        0% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.85) rotate(0deg); }
        100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.25) rotate(22deg); }
      }
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        #btn-magique-js-recap {
          top: calc(var(--topbar-h, 74px) + 6px);
          right: 8px;
          padding: 7px 12px;
          font-size: 11.5px;
        }
      }
      @media print {
        #btn-magique-js-recap, #jsRecapModal { display: none !important; }
      }

      /* ==== Boîte modale pour Recap-JavaScript ==== */
      .js-recap-modal {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 120;
        background: rgba(5, 7, 14, 0.78);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 1rem;
      }
      .js-recap-modal[hidden] {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .js-recap-box {
        background: #0a0c14;
        color: var(--text);
        border: 1px solid rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.38);
        border-radius: 14px;
        width: min(1240px, 96vw);
        max-height: 94vh;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75), 0 0 28px rgba(247, 223, 30, 0.14);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .js-recap-modal.full {
        padding: 0;
      }
      .js-recap-modal.full .js-recap-box {
        width: 100vw;
        height: 100vh;
        max-height: 100vh;
        border-radius: 0;
        border: none;
      }
      .js-recap-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
